    StartersRon's lighthouse wingsFloured fried wings tossed in a honey, sriracha and soy glazeHow to make it1.2kg chicken wings150g plain flour1 jar smoked paprika1 jar garlic powder100ml honey3 tbsp sriracha2 tbsp soy sauce1 L vegetable oilToss the chicken wings in the flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt.Fry in the vegetable oil at 175°C for 10 minutes until golden and cooked through.Simmer the honey, the sriracha and the soy until glossy and toss the wings through.Doby's lighthouse fish bitesPanko crumbed white fish bites with lemon and tartare sauceHow to make it500g white fish fillets50g plain flour2 eggs100g panko breadcrumbs1 lemon150g tartare sauce1 L vegetable oilCut the white fish into bite-size pieces.Roll in the flour, the beaten eggs, then the panko and fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C for 3 minutes until golden.Serve with lemon wedges and the tartare sauce.Fried shrimp basket with tartareDoby the shark gets the leftovers.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsGNN late shift steakGarlic butter sirloin with oven fries and creamed spinachHow to make it4 sirloin steaks50g butter2 garlic cloves1kg frozen chips400g spinach100ml thickened creamBake the frozen chips following the packet.Season the sirloin steaks and sear in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side, then baste with the butter and the crushed garlic cloves.Rest 5 minutes.Serve with the oven fries and the spinach wilted with the cream.Champ Kind's Chicken of the CaveChamp swears it's chicken. It's chicken here, we checkedHow to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets300ml buttermilk2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder200g plain flour1 L vegetable oil3 tbsp honey1 tsp chilli flakes300g white cabbage3 tbsp mayonnaise100g dill picklesSoak the chicken in the buttermilk with half the paprika and salt for at least 20 minutes.Mix the flour with the rest of the paprika, the garlic powder and salt. Toss the chicken in it, pressing to coat.Heat the oil to 170°C and fry in batches for 6 to 7 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack.Warm the honey with the chilli flakes.Toss the shredded cabbage with the mayonnaise and salt and serve with the chicken, hot honey and pickles.SweetsLinda's chocolate fondueWarm dark chocolate and cream fondue for dipping strawberriesHow to make it250g dark chocolate200ml thickened cream250g strawberries150g marshmallows1 sponge cakeMelt the dark chocolate with the cream and a pinch of salt over low heat, stirring until smooth.Pour into a warm bowl and serve with the strawberries, the marshmallows and a cut-up sponge cake for dipping.DrinksRon's Scotch Rob RoyBlended Scotch, sweet vermouth and bitters, stirred and chilledHow to make it240ml blended Scotch whisky100ml sweet vermouth1 tsp aromatic bitters4 brandied cherries1 orange4 cups iceChill the coupes in the freezer.For each drink, fill a mixing glass with ice and add the blended Scotch, the sweet vermouth and a few dashes of aromatic bitters.Stir for 30 seconds until very cold.Strain into the chilled coupe and drop in a brandied or maraschino cherry.Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and discard it.Vanilla milkshake, two strawsFor Brick and Chani, shared at the desk.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
